sketches.mechanism: SQL three-valued logic makes NULL = NULL evaluate to UNKNOWN, and WHERE returns only rows whose predicate is TRUE.
sketches.resonance: What is missing cannot even prove itself to itself, so the row vanishes without being deleted.

sketches.mechanism: The pin operator ^ forces a pattern to match an already-bound value instead of rebinding it, raising MatchError on change.
sketches.resonance: A vow can be recognized again, but cannot be quietly rewritten into its opposite.

sketches.mechanism: dup requires an existing stack item to copy; invoking it on an empty stack causes stack underflow.
sketches.resonance: Nothing cannot be echoed, because absence gives the machine no body to repeat.
